outcome: Brain volumetry (basal ganglia, gray matter, white matter, cerebellum, cortical gyri, hippocampus, thalamus, subcortical regions)
Neurodevelopmental outcomes (motor, cognitive, language domains assessed by Bayley Scale III)
cohort: The study enrolled 34 term neonates with perinatal asphyxia, with 12 receiving therapeutic hypothermia and 22 serving as controls without hypothermia.
finding: Therapeutic hypothermia in term neonates with perinatal asphyxia led to significantly larger gray matter, white matter, and hippocampal volumes compared to controls.
